zoe: FYI daily rollup shows ~2.8% undercount vs shadow replay. Pattern looks like missing spans during ETL retries again. tagging data + infra.
rajesh: saw a consumer rebalance 01:42 UTC that paused partitions briefly. log: 
```
2026-03-26T01:42:09Z WARN consumer: rebalance, paused [1,4]
2026-03-26T01:50:15Z INFO consumer: resumed
```
marta: that aligns with the aggregator join window. suggestion: short-term: alert on consumer-lag >5m + targeted reingest for affected partitions. medium-term: add ingest_sequence + tolerant dedupe.
oncall-bot: incident-created: "rollup-under-count" severity: P3. runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/rollup-issues
zoe: proposed owners: rajesh -> alert + reingest script (ETA 2026-03-27), marta -> validation notebook & impacted-customer list (ETA 2026-03-27), zoe -> postmortem tracking and recurrence cadence (start 2026-03-28). plan: online tolerant patch behind FF first, replay if delta >1%.
rajesh: will add alert + partition map today. ETA for map: 2026-03-27 10:00 UTC.
marta: validation steps: replay small windows, diff key-hit rates, sanity-check billing totals. I'll publish notebook and link.
zoe: action recap in postmortem doc https://redwood.internal/postmortems/rollup-recurrence-2026. blockers? :eyes:
